rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for unnatural or awkward movement, speech, or acting.

example.english: The way they speak sounds very wooden.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dak1 hou2 saang1 ngaang6

rows.note: Use this instead of 生硬 when the main point is stiff or awkward physical movement.

example.english: My legs got wooden from the cold.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 goek3 dung3 dou3 goeng1 ngaang6 saai3

rows.note: Use this when wooden performance or speech specifically sounds emotionally flat.

example.jyutping: keoi5 baa2 seng1 teng1 lok6 mou5 gam2 cing4

rows.note: Use this for an object that is physically made of wood.

example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 hai6 jung6 muk6 zou6 ge3
